description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Prices one transparent video with exactly the builder's choices, without spending credits or creating anything. Returns a planId (valid 24 hours, single-use) and the exact credit cost -- show it to the user and get confirmation before calling create_transparent_video. Pass projectId to make a new version in an existing project (the builder's Remake); leave it out to start a new project.

durationSec.description: Video length in seconds. Default 8. Standard and Pro: 5-15. Seamless loop: 3-15.

modelTier.description: Older field: standard, kling (= motion pro) or exact (= seamlessLoop).

motion.description: Motion quality, like the builder: standard (default, reliable everyday motion) or pro (smoother, more detailed).

palette.description: Older field, ignored: the builder uses fixed colours.

projectId.description: Optional. A transparent video project to add this version to.

projectName.description: Optional name for a new project. Without one, the project is named from the prompt, like the builder.

prompt.description: Describe the video, up to 2000 characters.

referenceImagePath.description: Optional reference image from upload_video_reference_image or get_video_reference_image_status (needed for seamlessLoop).

referenceImageUrl.description: Older field: an https link to a PNG with a transparent background. Prefer upload_video_reference_image.

seamlessLoop.description: Defaults false. Animates the reference image as a seamless loop; needs referenceImagePath and is always silent.

sound.description: Defaults false. Not available with seamlessLoop.

name: plan_transparent_video
title: Plan a transparent video
